Fix: add the run to the Runs table, add HISTORICAL.md, and move the '(latest)' pointer.

findings.note: NEW at 7dd0402: docs/CI.md:146-155 and .github/workflows/chromatic.yml:30-43 present the webpack 5.101.2 pin as a future remediation option that 'needs a dedicated PR', while the pin is already in the tree — root package.json:84 'webpack': '5.101.2' under pnpm.overrides and the lockfile resolves webpack@5.101.2 for storybook (pnpm-lock.yaml).
